claim: Patchline ships a learned reviewer-preference model gated by a fairness-across-teams constraint. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the fairness-across-teams claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make reviewer-preference-fairness-gate`.
